_comment: A cold start (120x40): the first refresh is in flight and nothing has landed yet, so there is no snapshot, no prs block and no herdr block. Every pane shows its spinner line: loading fleet snapshot… in the four snapshot panes, loading GitHub checks… in My PRs, loading GitHub review requests… in To review. The snapshot-landed, failed-first-fetch, frame and narrow variants are derived from it at run time.
